# Reproducibility notes

## Test 1

JR Ferrer-Paris /  30 Oct 2026

Three lines of code in the command line / terminal:

```
git clone https://github.com/Ecosystem-Indicators-Workflows/workflow_example_Gidgee.git
cd workflow_example_Gidgee
quarto render Gidgee_workflow_2026.qmd
```

First try failed:
```
20/35 [Step 7 Run the baseline SDM]  
`Failed with error:  'there is no package called 'rJava''`
```

Fixed: added `rJava` to the vector of required packages in [Step 0 Requirements]

Second try succeeded!
